_meta.description: Per-metric anomaly thresholds as fractional daily change. >0.10 = 10%. If a scraped value deviates from previous by more than threshold, write is SKIPPED and Discord alert fires. Exception: gross_reserves_usd_bn is a MONTHLY series (bb_forex) — its band only applies to a same-month revision of an already-published figure, never to a normal month-to-month step, which is accepted regardless of magnitude. gross_reserves_usd_bn_advance_drop / _advance_jump are a SIGNED, asymmetric pair for that month-to-month step itself — warn-only (never blocks the write): BD fiscal-year-end (June) reserves spike hard and legitimately (positive), so the jump limit is wide, while a wrong-column read (e.g. BPM6 vs gross) shows up as a large drop (negative), so the drop limit is tighter.
